name: Brandenburg
summary: Two horizontal bands of red over white with the state arms in the centre: a red eagle on a white shield. The red eagle of Brandenburg has been the symbol of the margraviate since the 12th century.
origin: The red eagle was the emblem of the Margraviate of Brandenburg, the core of the later Kingdom of Prussia. The state was re-established in 1990, and its flag was adopted that year.

symbols.name: Red eagle
symbols.description: A red eagle with gold claws and wing-clasps on white.

facts: Brandenburg was the heartland of Prussia.
clues: Red over white with a red eagle on a white shield.
Its eagle belonged to the margraves who founded Prussia.
A German state surrounding the capital.
